programme.title: A South Carolina Family Reunion
programme.desc: For his reunion inspired menu Chef Derrell Smith is going back to his roots. Cookin’ up some modern takes on the family classics including his Garlic Pesto Potato Salad, Salmon Filet, a Herby, Spicy Kale Slaw, and Grilled Fruit Skewers.

programme.title: Happy Birthday to Me
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith’s birthday and he’s treating himself to some self love and a lavish steak dinner inspired by a famous NYC steakhouse. On the menu: Rib Eye Steak with Peppercorn Sauce, Duck Frites, Wedge Salad and a celebratory carrot cake.

programme.title: Grandma Estelle
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith’s grandma inspired him in life and in the kitchen. He shares family recipes taking him right back to grandma's table. He's cookin' up Fried Chicken, Mac ‘N Cheese, Collard Green Slaw, Brûlée Banana Pudding and Pop-pops moonshine.

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: This week finds Dr. Matt grappling with wild cats, a juvenile delinquent donkey, too many male lemurs and a penguin with a eye problem.

programme.title: Scruffts
programme.desc: Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".nnBut they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've got stupid vs intelligent dogs, talented dogs, sporty dogs, pug life, dogs getting stuck, sleepy dogs, and dogs acting like humans.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Baxter is a Shih-Tzu that was discovered abandoned in an empty house on the outskirts of Manchester; thin and with extremely matted fur. Inspector Lyndsey Taylor comes to the rescue, but until all that fur is removed, nobody knows what lies beneath.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: A crazy animal expert raises hundreds of pets in their workplace; the super cute characteristics and breeding secrets of pet turtles are revealed; elementary school students' favorite beetle army attacks, tailor-made insect jelly taste super delicious; and animal therapist is now on duty, "Cute Pet Guide" takes you to visit a parent-child farm and get close to various cute pets.

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt tries to perk up Spike the iguana who's down in the dumps and he meets the latest fascinating additions to the aquarium the magical but very endangered seahorses. But he also faces every vet's nightmare during an operation on a budgie.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: At an address in the Wirral, Inspector Anthony Joynes finds two collie crosses, Patch and Socks. Both dogs are in very poor condition and Anthony needs to get them out. Inspector Herchy Boal is called to Scooby's rescue. She's collapsed with puncture wounds after fighting with two other dogs. Scooby is in shock so she needs urgent medical care.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium. Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria. However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild. Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market. Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone.

programme.title: Broadcast
programme.desc: After a billionaire creates a drug called INOC which stops the aging process, the future of a world where death no longer exists is seen. The story of the fate of mankind is told while also revealing an elusive truth to its unknowing spectator.

programme.title: Blowback
programme.desc: After planning a perfect heist, Nick is ready to score. One problem, his girl and the crew, have other ideas. They take Nick down in a hail of bullets but Nick doesn't die and in a race for his life, seeks revenge one target at a time.

programme.title: Mayfair - Shooting Paul
programme.desc: Hoping to put the past behind him and go legit, Max is persuaded by Paul to open a new Mister Mayfair club in Portugal. Conflict, however, seems to follow Max wherever he goes. Drawn into a violent turf war between London Gangsters and the Italian Mafia, his relationship with Ava is jeopardised by the arrival of his former flame, Serena. Max’s carefully crafted world seems to be collapsing around him. With his family’s lives on the line, Max is blackmailed by British crime boss, Tommy, to assassinate his best friend, Paul.

programme.title: Operation Sea Wolf
programme.desc: The German Navy and the last remaining U-Boats, were formed together for one last mission to attack the United States Homeland.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - The Spyce Of Life
programme.desc: Returning from a romantic getaway with Ava, Max finds himself on the wrong side of the law yet again. Now blackmailed by MI6, Max must spy on two suspected terrorists; Aziz and Omar, who are regular customers at his club. Accompanied by his London crime family, Max breaks into Omar’s country estate and discovers his sinister plan. With everything on the line, Max must race to uncover a highly skilled hacker’s identity before it’s too late.

programme.title: American Sicario

programme.desc: Four friends wanted to get away from it all in a remote country house but when a mysterious injured man turns up on their doorstep telling tales of a city ravaged by a epidemic and the looters who have pursued him, the friends rally to help.

programme.title: Altitude
programme.desc: A female FBI agent is offered millions to help a thief escape from a hijacked airplane.

programme.desc: A former MMA fighter and his brothers must rescue their kidnapped family from a dangerous crime syndicate after $50M of illegal diamonds gets stolen.

programme.title: High Voltage
programme.desc: After a lightning strike kills the lead singer of a band, she is resurrected with electrifying special abilities.

programme.title: Johnny & Clyde

programme.desc: A Las Vegas casino magnate, determined to find a new avenue for wagering, sets up a race for money.

programme.desc: Refusing to comply with Tommy’s demands, Max and Paul conspire to have the British gangster eliminated and Serena arrested. With Tommy dead and Serena in handcuffs, it appears as though Max has succeeded. His plan goes awry, however, when MI6 force Max to help Serena bring down her employers: the Russian mob. Torn between a life of crime with Serena or happiness with Ava, nothing is ever simple in the life of Max Mayfair.

programme.title: The Competition
programme.desc: No information available

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Tormented by his criminal past, Clean attempts a quiet life caring for his community and as a mentor to his young neighbor Dianda. When local gang violence puts his neighbor’s life in danger, Clean finds himself returning to his violent past.

programme.title: Broadcast
programme.desc: After a billionaire creates a drug called INOC which stops the aging process, the future of a world where death no longer exists is seen. The story of the fate of mankind is told while also revealing an elusive truth to its unknowing spectator.

programme.title: Blowback
programme.desc: After planning a perfect heist, Nick is ready to score. One problem, his girl and the crew, have other ideas. They take Nick down in a hail of bullets but Nick doesn't die and in a race for his life, seeks revenge one target at a time.

programme.title: Mayfair - Shooting Paul
programme.desc: Hoping to put the past behind him and go legit, Max is persuaded by Paul to open a new Mister Mayfair club in Portugal. Conflict, however, seems to follow Max wherever he goes. Drawn into a violent turf war between London Gangsters and the Italian Mafia, his relationship with Ava is jeopardised by the arrival of his former flame, Serena. Max’s carefully crafted world seems to be collapsing around him. With his family’s lives on the line, Max is blackmailed by British crime boss, Tommy, to assassinate his best friend, Paul.

programme.title: Operation Sea Wolf
programme.desc: The German Navy and the last remaining U-Boats, were formed together for one last mission to attack the United States Homeland.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - The Spyce Of Life
programme.desc: Returning from a romantic getaway with Ava, Max finds himself on the wrong side of the law yet again. Now blackmailed by MI6, Max must spy on two suspected terrorists; Aziz and Omar, who are regular customers at his club. Accompanied by his London crime family, Max breaks into Omar’s country estate and discovers his sinister plan. With everything on the line, Max must race to uncover a highly skilled hacker’s identity before it’s too late.

programme.title: American Sicario
programme.desc: Based on the true story, Edgar Valdez, drug lord and cartel leader, is betrayed by one of the brothers. Seeking retribution, Valdez will risk it all to gain control of the Feliz cartel.

programme.title: In Isolation
programme.desc: Four friends wanted to get away from it all in a remote country house but when a mysterious injured man turns up on their doorstep telling tales of a city ravaged by a epidemic and the looters who have pursued him, the friends rally to help.

programme.title: Altitude
programme.desc: A female FBI agent is offered millions to help a thief escape from a hijacked airplane.

programme.title: The Legion
programme.desc: Noreno, a half-Roman, is entrusted with the mission of crossing the snowy mountains of Armenia, swarming with Parthian patrols, to seek help for his slowly dying men.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S04:E05 - Hyabusa
programme.desc: La misión japonesa de retorno de muestras de asteroides ha alcanzado su objetivo y está inspeccionando la roca espacial, lista para sumergirse y adquirir su muestra. El retorno a la Tierra de material procedente de asteroides ayudará a los científicos a desarrollar sistemas de defensa planetaria.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S04:E06 - Fresh Eyes
programme.desc: Dos nuevos telescopios espaciales, Gaia y TESS, están en órbita con sus misiones principales llegando a su fin. A ellos se unirá el telescopio James Webb, y juntos abrirán un nuevo panorama en el tiempo y el espacio.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E12 - The New Royals
programme.desc: Princesses Beatrice and Eugenie have gone through a lot of media attention and tough situations in their lives. From their parents' very public split to being targeted by the press, they've been through quite a bit. Despite all this, they remain dedicated to supporting the monarchy with their charity work. Through serving the Commonwealth, both sisters continue to make a positive impact.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E02 - White Gold
programme.desc: Ivan Carter trabaja para salvar a un elefante clave de los cazadores furtivos de marfil cerca del famoso Parque Nacional Kruger de África.

programme.title: Dropped - S08:E03 - Arctic Apex

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S05:E05 - Bond-ing with Larry
programme.desc: 誰是有史以來最偉大的國際動作英雄，Terry Schappert？不。Terry和Larry測試了一些詹姆斯·邦德電影和其他偉大動作英雄的場景。

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S05:E06 - Across the Great Divided Lonesome Mighty River
programme.desc: 每個人都喜歡偉大的西部片。 除了拉里。 泰瑞讓拉里測試更多經典西部電影的場景。

programme.title: The New Frontier - S04:E07 - Martian Attractions
programme.desc: This is the latest in Martian exploration, not just from orbit but also from rovers on the ground. New sources of water and planetary dust storms are a few of the stories unfolding on the Red Planet.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S04:E08 - Cubes
programme.desc: Los cubesats son satélites en miniatura que se han utilizado exclusivamente en órbita terrestre baja durante 15 años. Ahora, estos pequeños satélites están ganando popularidad y se utilizan también para misiones interplanetarias. Incluso se han enviado a Marte con la misión Insight, con la esperanza de comprender mejor el planeta rojo, nuestro sistema solar y más allá.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E13 - Hunt and Capture Saddam Hussein
programme.desc: Hace diez años, miles de efectivos de las fuerzas estadounidenses y de la Coalición, desde soldados de élite hasta reservistas, se encontraron en medio de dos conflictos que requerían un enfoque de la guerra totalmente distinto al que habían experimentado hasta entonces. Desde unidades de fuerzas especiales asegurando puntos vitales de interés estratégico y capturando a individuos clave en Afganistán. Este episodio de CQB analiza de cerca cómo se integraron las operaciones especiales en las unidades regulares y cómo lucharon en muchas situaciones de combate cuerpo a cuerpo con una combinación de inteligencia, armamento de alta tecnología y tecnologías de vigilancia para encontrar y capturar a Sadam Husein.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E01 - Riggins Gold
programme.desc: Hoy en Fiebre del Oro, Tom y su hija Kia se encuentran en el caudaloso río Salmón, buscando pepitas de oro bajo el agua. kwadventure

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E17 - Remembering Diana Princess Of Wales
programme.desc: 回憶威爾士的戴安娜公主包括她國葬的場景和她親密朋友們的感人言辭。這是一個對戴安娜的溫暖而深思的看法，既是作為一個人，也是作為一個公共人物：那位從未成為女王的公主，和將永遠被銘記的公主。

programme.desc: Ivan Carter revela las duras decisiones de África cuando investiga el asesinato de un hipopótamo.

programme.desc: 當太陽升起時，它為山谷注入生命，動物開始四處活動。

programme.title: Dropped - S08:E06 - Stay Or Go
programme.desc: There's still a long way to go on the journey, but should the brothers let animals go to look for other animals?

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S05:E07 - Down Mexico Way
programme.desc: 不要與有組織犯罪作對。這個動力二人組正在挑戰來自墨西哥卡特爾系列《南方女王》的場景，但在洗手間停了一下，測試與成龍的《外來者》的場景。

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S05:E08 - Terry's Alone at Home
programme.desc: 誰讓特里獨自在家？拉里！加入特里和拉里，重現經典電影系列《小鬼當家》的幾個場景。

programme.title: The New Frontier - S04:E09 - Proving Einstein
programme.desc: Las pruebas para demostrar algunas de las teorías de Einstein habían sido esquivas durante mucho tiempo, más allá de las capacidades de la tecnología, hasta ahora. Parece que Einstein ha vuelto a triunfar al descubrir lo último en observaciones del espacio profundo.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S04:E10 - Where are all the Aliens?
programme.desc: Estamos buscando mucho, pero los números no cuadran. ¿Es tan difícil encontrar vida en otros planetas? ¿Existe siquiera? No hemos descubierto ni una sola señal, así que tal vez estemos realmente solos en nuestra parte de la galaxia.

programme.title: Jim Shockey's Uncharted - S01:E04 - The Bears that Couldn't Be
programme.desc: Temperate Rain Forest. Jim and Corey search for an epic hunting spot deep in the coastal rain forest of Vancouver Island that Jim last explored 20 years ago.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S04:E07 - Swimming with Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Manny nada con esturiones gigantes del golfo en el río Suwanee.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S04:E08 - Snapping Turtles of the Santa Fe
programme.desc: Manny explora el río Santa Fe en busca de caimanes, tortugas mordedoras y otros animales salvajes.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S04:E09 - Wild Boars, Wild Nights Part 1
programme.desc: Manny caza jabalíes eurasiáticos salvajes con una lanza, tanto de día como de noche. Ah, y a Manny le muerde su mejor amigo.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S04:E10 - Wild Boars, Wild Nights Part 2
programme.desc: ¡Saquen a los perros! Manny aprende la forma más eficaz de cazar jabalíes.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E03 - Biggest
programme.desc: The Biggest? An Elephant? A Giraffe? A Hippopotamus? Or the humpback whale which is three times longer than the tallest giraffe and weighs more than a dozen hippos. But which is the biggest of them all?

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E04 - Smartest
programme.desc: ¿Son inteligentes los animales? Por supuesto. Pero, ¿cuál es el más inteligente de todos? ¿El chimpancé socialmente complejo? ¿La ingeniosa araña bola? ¿La arquitectónica termita? ¿El curioso delfín? ¿O el inimitable pulpo?

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E05 - Strongest
programme.desc: ¿Cómo se decide cuál es el animal más fuerte del Planeta? Wild Ones compara la fuerza de la más pequeña de las hormigas con la de un poderoso oso pardo, o la de un cocodrilo mortal con la del indestructible rinoceronte.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E06 - Cutest
programme.desc: El encantador canguro. El adorable koala. La hermosa mariposa. El alegre pez payaso. O el adorable periquito: ¿cuál es el más mono de todos?

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E04 - Naturally Exotic
programme.desc: Este episodio de Milagros de la Naturaleza le lleva de viaje desde Antigua, en el Caribe, a las favoritas de los escaladores: las Montañas Azules de Nueva Gales del Sur, Australia, y luego de vuelta al Caribe para adentrarse en la belleza de las Islas Vírgenes Británicas, con impresionantes playas de arena blanca y aguas turquesas.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E05 - Naturally Fierce
programme.desc: Visite el invernal Polo Norte desde la comodidad de su sofá, ya que este episodio nos lleva de viaje al gélido Ártico y luego a Quebec para contemplar el fiordo más meridional en marea baja, antes de viajar a Alberta para contemplar la magnitud del río Sasquachuan a su paso por las Montañas Rocosas.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E06 - Naturally Forged
programme.desc: En este episodio de Milagros de la Naturaleza visita varias islas diferentes. Veremos las impresionantes terrazas rocosas de Taiwán y el majestuoso volcán de la mítica isla de Bali. Seguimos con la isla de Jersey, que da nombre a una parte de Nueva York, y por último visitamos la espectacular Madeira, que presenta una asombrosa variedad de paisajes a pesar de sus pocos kilómetros de longitud.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E07 - Naturally Majestic
programme.desc: Siga los pasos de Indiana Jones. En este episodio de Milagros de la Naturaleza visitamos las maravillas del desierto de Gobi, uno de los más antiguos del mundo, y luego las exuberantes y verdes laderas del norte de Mongolia. Desde allí viajaremos 5.000 kilómetros hacia el sureste, hasta Jordania y el Mar Muerto.

programme.title: The Marry Me Pact
programme.desc: 夏洛特和羅里是最好的朋友，為了慶祝他30歲生日，羅里去環遊世界。一年後，夏洛特去看了一位算命師，算命師告訴她她的命中註定是當羅里回來時和他在一起。羅里回來了……但他已經訂婚了。

programme.title: The Wedding Contest
programme.desc: 當一對夫婦無法決定婚禮主題時，他們雇了兩位婚禮策劃師，泰勒和本，讓他們透過提出兩種截然不同的風格來競爭這份工作。

programme.title: Love on the Reef
programme.desc: A smart and serious marine biologist and a fun-loving and laissez-faire dive instructor must team up to save their beloved reef from being destroyed before it's too late.

programme.title: Behind the Wheel of Revenge
programme.desc: 金（Kim），大家都知道她是一名优秀的學生且人緣很好，但在一次家庭聚會上發生意外后，她陷入了大麻煩。她決定開車，卻不應該這樣做，結果失控撞車，甚至差點傷害到她的一位同班同學。這給她和舉辦派對的人的父母帶來了很多困擾。

programme.title: Sorority Secrets
programme.desc: 卡西(Cassie)非常高興加入一個精英姐妹會，作為年中轉校生，還享受免費住宿、學費援助以及出色的校友網絡。然而，當卡西發現姐妹會的會長和顧問正在與姐妹會的女孩們經營一個陪伴服務時，她意識到這個小秘密可能會要了她的命……

programme.title: Rear View Mirror
programme.desc: 一位年輕的母親試圖逃離她控制且虐待的丈夫，在一個理想化、寧靜的海灘小鎮開始新的生活。

programme.title: A Bet with the Matchmaker
